svg.title: Local residual transpose and separated-head placement
svg.desc: Local11 values eight through fifteen store eight body bytes 01, then bitplane bytes aa cc f0. For twenty-bit values with eight-bit heads, one contiguous head array has one byte per row. Filtering scans this array before fetching payloads for candidate rows. A separate buffer contains 64-row payload tiles, each with 64 body bytes followed by 32 residual bytes. The arrays continue across many tiles without interleaved heads or gaps. Columns align by original row range; the two planes have different byte scales.

g.text: One bitplane byte per output row.
Bit 0 is shown first; byte values are hexadecimal.
Filter here; fetch payloads for candidate rows.
Each payload tile: 64 rows in 96 bytes.
Columns align by row range; byte scales differ.
